column1: Coding task capacity | 20 October 2026
Compare quality, cost AND runtime. Coding Agent Index v1.5 below; general AAII v4.3.2 is a separate worksheet and cannot be mixed with CAI scores.
Budgets are USD ceilings for one month. API attempts = FLOOR(budget / measured average task cost). They are not guaranteed solved tasks; score is not success probability.
Subscription rows use ONE eligible plan. Unspent money is retained. No account stacking, invented top-ups, or linear subscription quota scaling.
OpenCode: per-model caps; 20%/5h and50%/week. Context tiers and peak/off-peak rows share the same underlying model cap. Do not sum them.
Muse High15/mo includes Wonder; Power50/mo adds WonderFull. Both CLI-only. Numerical full-task quotas cannot be inferred from prompts/5h.
OpenDesign Design Plan credits are shared and model-weighted. Premium wallet is separate; off-peak/free promotions may be app-only, so not assumed in external CLI estimates.
AA current pages disagree on Muse Wonder64/$8.04 vs63/$8.05 and Spark cost. Uses Codex-vs-Muse snapshot, retains discrepancy. WonderFull $0 is a missing-price placeholder.
Current DeepSeekV4.1 uses archived AAII workload repriced for peak/off-peak. Older CAI V4Flash0731/V4Pro0813 are explicitly historical; not a current snapshot comparison.
ChatGPT/Claude numeric subscription counts are historical third-party scenarios from Oct5, not official quotas or a fresh measurement. See evidence column.
160-hour capacity is a runtime scenario, not a provider quota. Go_General_Task_Capacity gives tariff-ratio bounds; all four budgets afford Go/Plus, with unused cash retained.
